protocol: Fresh raw BOLD/SBRef and archived same-subject T1 -> original SynthStrip, FSL FAST/MCFLIRT/FLIRT/BBR/FNIRT/MELODIC/ICA-AROMA, independent NumPy joint nuisance regression, original FSL applywarp -> native and MNI clean.

t1_affine.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

t1_nonlinear.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

epi_affine.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

epi_bbr.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

t1_dense_warp.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

compose_epi_mni.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

inverse_bbr.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

wm_pve_to_epi.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

csf_pve_to_epi.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

epi_mask_to_mni.acceptance: Outputs verified; original exit codes retained.

python3_compatibility.changes: Remove Python-2 stdlib aliases; old_div alias uses truediv. All division operands in executed frequency/spatial functions are float scalars or float arrays.

confounds.method: independent NumPy float64 SVD joint projection, rcond=1e-8

aroma_temporal_mean_check.scope: Measured on retained native AROMA voxels; no assumed fsl_regfilt mean or implicit-mask rule.

validation_only_helper_change.reason: Real fslinfo shell query has interleaved execve start/resume; recursively prove nested launcher success through exec/exit/SIGCHLD without changing any exit code

timing_boundary: Continuous sequential workflow, including stage interpreter startup and in-stage integrity checks; input preflight hashing and final MNI integrity checks excluded. No skipped/reused computational stage.
limits: The complete chain outputs clean only; current FNIT volume also outputs T1w/MNI preproc. Use matching branch/stage boundaries rather than raw total ratios.
Each native command timer includes original startup, read/write and exec/exit tracing; validations are outside command timers but inside the continuous workflow.
Configured CPU threads are environment limits, not a claim that every original FSL command uses eight active cores.
One subject and one new run on a shared host; no stable speedup claim.
Same archived T1 reconstruction as previous benchmark, not verified scanner-raw T1.
privacy: Anonymous scalar checks and hashes only; no image arrays, raw paths, argv or subject IDs.
